verdict.rationale: Veriff documents a broad set of official client SDKs: native Android and iOS (with version requirements, NFC callbacks and a migration guide), React Native, a Flutter plugin, a JS SDK, and an InContext web SDK, all positioned as the recommended way to embed its verification flow. These SDKs are front-end and session-flow oriented, and backend integration relies on the raw REST API, a Postman collection and HMAC signing, with no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: official server-side/backend API client SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
